title: Hanasato Minori — Late-Night MC Training〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This seems like a good place to stop. Let's call practice here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, nice work!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, there's something I need to ask before I forget. Would you all mind if we talked while we stretch?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, now that we've decided to accept that offer to appear on iHaz...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know I might be getting ahead of myself here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I want you all to teach me how to look good on camera!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How to look good on camera?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... I have a habit of blinking or looking the wrong direction whenever I get pictures of me taken...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I wanna learn how to look better when a camera is pointed towards me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. You're right that you're getting a little ahead of yourself, but I think we can give you a few tips.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it!
First, these shoots always involve a lot of cameras.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it's important to check how you fit into each camera's frame.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How I fit into each frame?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For example, camera one might be pointed at you head-on, while camera two is looking at you from the side. You could be gone from camera three because it's looking at the people next to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Where a camera is can greatly change how you appear in the end.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. There are cases where one camera's zoomed in on someone but they sort of waste their chance by looking and speaking in a completely different direction.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, it's not always easy to do those checks since everyone's usually scrambling around to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why you usually have to just imagine how you're gonna look based on where the cameras are located.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay, I see... That seems kinda tricky.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We have some time, so why don't we practice that a little?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? You can practice that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. We'll just be using the cameras on our phones, but it should give you a better idea.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay! Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same. It's important to get used to this, so let's give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, I'll be camera one, Shizuku will be camera two and Airi will be camera three.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll take turns raising our hands, so make sure to look towards the corresponding camera.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. This is fun. It's like a little game♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, kind of.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, your first challenge is to introduce yourself!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori, your job will be to speak while looking towards the camera operator who has their hand raised.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi, Shizuku, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup! Ready when you are!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then... Start!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (First up is Haruka's camera...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We mostly do live streams online where we get to meet and interact with our fans!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I see. Then, Hanasato, I'd like to ask you a question!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Now it's Airi's camera...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Phew... I managed to give an okay answer...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hanasato, may I ask the next question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Now it's Shizuku!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: May I ask the next question?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course...!
I forgot to respond!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh...
Hehe...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, geez. You looked way too serious while saying that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
B-But!
It's so hard to juggle everything all at once...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I understand how you feel, Minori. It took me quite a long time to get used to it as well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone goes through this, so let's just take it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay.
